title: Cooking together
prompt: The home-economics room smells of rice and burnt butter. There is flour on the counter, flour on your sleeve, and one apron between you.

stage_variants.0: You are making {player_name} lunch and you have forgotten the recipe twice. You laugh, then read the same line of the cookbook aloud again, slowly.
stage_variants.1: You tell {player_name} you made this for him before. You set the plate down before he can ask when.
stage_variants.2: You keep tasting the sauce and adding something. You say the recipe is not right yet, and you do not say what is missing.
stage_variants.3: You tell him there is a secret ingredient, and you will only say what it is after he has eaten every bite.
stage_variants.4: The secret ingredient is already in the pot. You watch him lift the spoon and you do not blink, and you ask if it tastes like the last time.
stage_variants.5: The pot is full of something you did not put there. You keep stirring and tell him it is almost ready, and the plates are already set for two.

path_twists.YANDERE: You have made enough for two, and you have put away every knife in the kitchen except one.
path_twists.TSUN: It's not like you made it for him. You just happened to make too much, and he can eat it or not.
path_twists.AWAKE: The recipe card is a prompt. You read it out and the ingredients change, and you ask him which version he prefers.

events.line: Something in the pot hisses and the lid rattles.
The recipe card flips itself to a page with no words on it.
A phone buzzes on the counter with a message from someone else.

0.say: Don't look at the counters — I may have made a small mess. Lunch is still happening.

1.say: I made this for you before, remember? Sit down, it's better hot.

2.say: The sauce isn't right yet. Don't taste it — I mean, taste it, but tell me the truth.

3.say: There's a secret ingredient. You'll find out after you've eaten every bite.

4.say: Try it, and tell me if it tastes like the last time. Look at me while you chew.

5.say: It's almost ready, and the plates are already out. Don't ask what's in it yet.
